title: Skill Library File Format and Loader
description: Define .skill file format containing DSL function definitions with metadata header (name, description, input/output types, origin generation, fitness score, technique). Stored in ~/.ix/voyage/skills/. SkillLibrary.java loads .skill files and makes functions available to parser/runtime. CLIs accept --skill-dir to load skills. Exportable as text block for Daud system prompt injection. Depends on VOYAGE-8.
definition-of-done: 1. .skill file format defined with metadata header + DSL function body. 2. SkillLibrary.java loads all .skill files from a directory. 3. Loaded skills available as callable functions in DSL. 4. ValidateDsl and RenderDsl accept --skill-dir. 5. Text export of skill catalog for system prompt injection.
testing-plan: 1. Create a .skill file with a simple function. 2. Load it via SkillLibrary and call from a DSL script. 3. Verify ValidateDsl --skill-dir validates scripts using skills. 4. Verify text export format is LLM-readable.
todos: Define .skill file format with metadata header
Implement text export for system prompt injection
